opening.text: This is a Claude skill for making explainer videos. No video model is involved. Every frame you're watching is a web page.
opening.instructions: Warm, clear explainer narrator. Friendly and curious, measured pace.

storyboard.text: It starts with a storyboard. Claude plans each scene, with its narration and what should be on screen, then writes every scene as a small JavaScript module.
storyboard.instructions: Warm, clear explainer narrator. Friendly and curious, measured pace.

timeline.text: Scenes draw with HTML and SVG, and animate on GSAP timelines. The timelines stay paused, so any moment can be recreated exactly, just by seeking to it.
timeline.instructions: Warm, clear explainer narrator. Friendly and curious, measured pace.

render.text: To render, Playwright drives headless Chromium. It seeks one frame, takes a screenshot, and pipes it into ffmpeg. Four browsers work in parallel, so a minute of video renders in about a minute.
render.instructions: Warm, clear explainer narrator. Friendly and curious, measured pace.

review.text: Before the final render, Claude checks its own work. A linter flags layout and timing mistakes, and a contact sheet shows the whole video at a glance.
review.instructions: Warm, clear explainer narrator. Friendly and curious, measured pace.

voice.text: The voiceover comes from OpenRouter, using models like ElevenLabs or Gemini. Pauses measured in the audio let each animation land on the word it shows, like this one.
voice.instructions: Warm, clear explainer narrator. Friendly and curious, measured pace.

recap.text: Write the storyboard, render the frames, add a voice. Ask Claude for an explainer, and this is what you get.
recap.instructions: Warm, clear explainer narrator. Friendly and curious, measured pace.
